name: Snapshot Update Check
description: Flags unexpected snapshot test changes after test runs, ensuring snapshot updates are intentional rather than accidental
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Flag unexpected snapshot changes after test runs
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '(vitest|jest).*(-u|--update)'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  CHANGED=$(cd "$ROOT" && git diff --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -c '__snapshots__')
  if [[ $CHANGED -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "WARNING: $CHANGED snapshot file(s) were updated. Review changes:"
    cd "$ROOT" && git diff --stat -- '*/__snapshots__/*' 2>/dev/null | head -10
    echo "Ensure these snapshot changes are intentional."
  fi
fi
exit 0
